title: MVS and modern z/OS execution authority
summary: ED209Z on ED209C is the first MVS 3.8J TK5 test target; ED209ZZ on ED209I is a distinct second target and not a fallback alias. A historical RecordSet job RSQQUAL was accepted by JES and ended in assembler RC16/JCL failure; link and GO did not execute. An approved modern z/OS account that permits custom native load modules has not been confirmed.
invariants: Do not convert a JES acceptance into a successful execution claim.
An assembler RC16 and GO NOT_RUN are retained as a failure observation, not hidden by subsequent design work.
Never assume trial z/OS access grants development/deployment rights; verify explicit permission for compiler output, JES and load libraries.
Use the existing sshnode.sh authority for remote ED209 interaction where available; do not invent credentials or operate guests from this sphere.
Do not mix ed209c/ed209z identity or mainframe-native code with a host ooRexx/Hercules control-plane script.

provenance.claim: Documented source/evidence; independent guest qualification not implied
